name: Ningbo Bird Co.,Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Fenghua, China, Ningbo Bird Co.,Ltd. was established in 1992 and specializes in the production and sale of mobile devices and system equipment. Its offerings, primarily for the Chinese market, encompass various phone types—including Android, bar, qwerty, and clamshell designs—as well as tablet computers. Beyond its domestic operations, the company boasts a global reach, exporting its goods to approximately 60 nations worldwide, with a notable presence in countries such as France, Italy, across Europe, Russia, India, Mexico, and Brazil.
